candidates.claim: Enforcing read-only OverlayFS mounts for input dependencies during stage execution eliminates race conditions where commands modify their own inputs prior to digest verification.
candidates.falsifiable_conditions: Falsified if an unprivileged user execution environment lacks kernel OverlayFS mount permissions or if file system read-only locks introduce unacceptable IOPS latency overhead.

candidates.claim: 在開啟 lazytime 掛載選項的 ext4 檔案系統上，結合 Linux IMA/EVM 擴充屬性 (xattr) 與 fanotify 事件，構建核心級物理鐵錨，實現免於 I/O 寫入風暴的即時雜湊一致性校驗。
candidates.falsification_conditions: 若在非同步寫回（async writeback）及 lazytime 掛載模式下，突發斷電導致 Inode Disk Block 未刷盤，而資料區塊已寫入，系統重新開機後 lstat 返回舊 mtime 但檔內容已變更，若 IMA 雜湊未強制重新計算而直接信任舊 mtime，則驗證推論成立；反之若核心透過 i_version 或 journal 重新整理觸發強制失效，則推論被證偽。

candidates.claim: Applying a post-checkout mtime preservation wrapper with os.utime() restores pre-checkout POSIX timestamps on hardlinked workspace paths, neutralizing Snakemake DAG misjudgments.
candidates.falsifiable_conditions: Falsified if workspace file counts exceed 10^6 causing os.utime batch execution to violate the 30-second SLO, or if non-privileged container environments lack filesystem permission to alter symlink mtimes.
